scope: M2C-02b-3a local operator read-only journal inspection, not a recovery or retry command
prior_upload_boundary: Earlier code-upload security block remains. No retry, split upload, alternative route or remote source-in-document upload.

executed.strict_typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.independent.json; production core/Workspace/operator CLI plus independent tests, not full server
executed.test_command: node --test compiled/test/recovery-inspection.test.js compiled/test/recovery-runtime.test.js compiled/test/durable-journal.test.js compiled/test/durable-crash.test.js compiled/test/mutation-coordinator.test.js compiled/test/mutation-workspace.test.js compiled/test/modular-cli.test.js compiled/test/modular-files-process.test.js
executed.real_cli: Compiled operator CLI executed as a Node child process. Exit 0 observation completed, exit 2 review required, exit 1 blocked; JSON output inspected.
executed.crash: Actual worker SIGKILL after an effect and before terminal receipt; separate operator CLI reports unresolved, preserves one effect and every record.
executed.nonmutation: Snapshots of file sets, bytes, modes, inodes, mtime and ctime before/after read-only inspection; atime is intentionally excluded.
executed.current_file: Exact-case canonical path retained. Matching, externally changed and policy-blocked files checked without rewriting history.
executed.bounds_privacy: Pagination cap 200 and capacity-bound enumeration, metadata revalidation, unexpected entries, symlink/hardlink/unsafe file rejection, no raw IDs/scopes/paths/fingerprints/receipt hashes in default output.

not_run: Actual SDK/HTTP/stdio/Worker integration for new M2c code
limits: Read-only is no intentional writes, deletes, chmod, retries or subprocess effects; ordinary reads may update filesystem atime.
Inventory is not an atomic snapshot. An unfinished record can still be active, not necessarily abandoned.
Page results do not assert health of the whole namespace. No output grants permission for automatic re-execution.
A succeeded receipt is historical; matching current bytes do not prove the actor or exactly-once execution.
Operator CLI is not exposed as an MCP tool, does not load runtime config or start app/network services.
Existing user E0/E1 evidence remains tied to earlier remote code, not this unpublished review.
